hypothesis: Learn adaptation prior odds from source-only held-task prediction, retaining target evidence updates, instead of estimating a volatile target predictive weight from 8-23 labels.
single_change: Replace A9 model prior adaptation probability 0.5 by a source-calibrated probability, separately for each actual source archive and prior type. Preserve P0/P1 source components, family/rho priors, total variance and observation likelihood.
offline_fit: For each seed/archive/prior, use all eight held-source paths from A11. On each source forecast, p0 is the A9 null posterior mass after strictly earlier labels. For prior adaptation probability q, score Pq(next|history)=[(1-q)*p0*P0+q*(1-p0)*P1]/[(1-q)*p0+q*(1-p0)]. Sum log densities over all 8x16 forecasts.
uncertainty_rule: Uniform reference density on q in [0,1]; integrate exp(source CV score(q)) times this density using 64-point Gauss-Legendre quadrature. Use its mean q as the learned prior model probability. Do not select a hard maximum or tune a temperature. These are empirical predictive calibration weights, not an exact Bayesian posterior over the overlapping source folds.
target_update: For each old target forecast, apply the learned q to its existing P0/P1 densities and A9 null mass by the same normalized formula. The resulting target model weight updates from earlier paid target evidence. No target labels, scores, regimes or verifier outcomes enter q fitting.
source_archive_mapping: Four ordinary source regimes use their common shared archive. separate_head_structure uses the actual separate_heads archive. This reflects the source generator, not selection by target performance.
implementation: Reuse A11 and A10 saved exact conditional model scores and null posterior masses; no new source fit, simulation, KG or search is necessary. Verify normalization and the formula against the original branch mixture.
primary_endpoint: Mean calibrated-minus-original-source next-label log score on steps 9-24 in every target regime and both source priors; preserve all 16 seed blocks.
controls: Original source P0 and unmodified A9, both on the same historical queries. Report learned q by archive and prior; no variant selection by target results.
checks: q=0/0.5/1 recovers source/A9/adapted forecasts; dense branch reweighting equals the probability formula; target-score changes cannot change source-fitted q; compare 64/128/192-point q integration.
promotion_condition: Broad learned-prior target predictive improvement without material compatible-regime regression before any retrospective recommendation assessment. A failed condition ends this stage without automatic model expansion; prospective searches remain on hold.
limitations: Empirical calibration reuses development source archives; source folds overlap and targets reuse old query policies. Source examples are compatible and lack high-frequency/support shifts, so source calibration cannot validate such shifts. Seven-task CV calibration is applied to eight-task full source fits. Predictions do not establish decision or independent confirmation gains.
marginalization: For one source/adapted indicator per target function, integrating its q prior uses only mean(q); target branch weights retain their earlier-data likelihood ratios. Source calibration weights are empirical, not a posterior from an independent source likelihood.
